description: Replay look-ahead: each mutation lets a replay decide an event with a number or a swing not yet available at that candle. The replay no-repaint properties cannot see a bounded look-ahead -- it reads candles a prefix run has as well, so both runs publish the same wrong answer (measured 2026-09-13: even a cut at every candle caught these in 0-4 of 20 series, and three isolated battery runs caught 0/4). Each mutation is therefore pinned by a deterministic regression test; the properties run alongside. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/replay_properties.json

mutations.name: structure: BOS epsilon taken from the window's last ATR
mutations.old: atrs[candle_index] if candle_index < len(atrs) else None

mutations.name: structure: BOS may break a swing not yet confirmed at that candle
shift: CHoCH/MSS decided on external swings not yet confirmed
shift: internal swings used before they confirm
